Oxidian | https://www.oxidian.com | Remote (EU only)

We're doing to government software what challenger banks did to banking. We build critical systems for scientists and researchers, making sure public money is well invested.

Our work involves high-performance Python for petabyte-scale Earth Observation and satellite datasets, clean web UIs for complex data, and modern DevOps pipelines to automate scientific workflows.

Small team, fast-moving. Trust and autonomy from day one. No bureaucracy, just hard problems and impact.

We're hiring mid and senior Python Developers with 3+ years of experience.

Send your CV and a couple of paragraphs on why you're interested to careers@oxidian.com with the role in the subject line.
